text:
tess: PM asked for a "policy dry-run" in Console so teams can preview automatic fallback effects without flipping live. quick brainstorm?
maria: must be clearly labelled simulated. show per-route fallback rate timeseries, top triggers, and an estimated cost/latency delta.
dan: api sketch: POST /policies/:id/dryrun {duration, sample_rate} -> preview_id. GET /dryrun/:id/metrics and /dryrun/:id/samples. replay -> POST /dryrun/:id/replay/:sample_id. runtime will tag events `dry_run=true`.
lee: privacy: only store anonymized samples by default. default sample_rate 2%. retention 7d. opt-in 30d. 2FA confirm to promote.
ops-bot: [system] preview-service canary deployed (build: preview-2026-03-22).
maria: UX: banner "Dry-run mode: simulated only", main cards: timeseries, reasons breakdown, cost/latency estimate, right rail sample list (anonymized) with "Replay in sandbox".
dan: telemetry fields to standardize: `evt_type`, `route`, `policy_id`, `preview_id`, `dry_run`, `trigger`, `reason_code`, `sample_id`, `region`. avoid freeform reasons.
tess: great. meeting tomorrow 11 to split tasks: runtime hook, API, pipeline, and UX mock.
